notes: Physical public gathering with domestic constitutional-policy demand. ERR and Estonian World independently report the 18 October Tallinn event (approx. 300 and 250-300). Their accounts agree on location, date and referendum issue. This is not coded as a party-support election rally: the reports describe opposition to a proposed constitutional policy. Candidate remains pending independent scientific review and baseline comparison.
open_questions: Determine whether the reported PPA detention counts as an arrest under the manual; do not infer from silence.
End time and subsequent continuity remain unknown.
title: Marriage-equality rally opposing proposed constitutional referendum in Tallinn
organizer: Noored Sotsiaaldemokraadid (Social Democratic Party youth wing), with other political party representatives, Estonian LGBT Union and volunteers (ERR report).
threshold_50_evidence: ERR reports around 300 and Estonian World reports approximately 250-300 people at the same Tallinn site; both sources independently establish more than 50.

start_date.summary: ERR page timestamp and account place the event Sunday 18 October 2020.

demands.summary: Reports connect the rally to the proposed constitutional marriage-definition referendum; Estonian World names the proposal as EKRE's while noting it was a coalition party. Organizers/supporters sought legalization of gender-neutral marriage.

participants.summary: ERR estimates about 300; Estonian World estimates 250-300. Both refer to one Tallinn gathering.

threshold_50.summary: The lower reported estimate is approximately 250, well above 50.

protester_violence.summary: A scuffle is reported after counter-protesters interrupted; responsibility for violence against the state is not established.

state_response.summary: PPA took one individual to station to ascertain what happened; classification as arrest is unclear. Other response dimensions unknown.

notes: ERR explicitly describes this as a similar but separate Tartu demonstration earlier in October. The exact day and organizers are not supplied. Kept distinct from the 18 October Tallinn gathering; no national pooling inferred.
open_questions: Search for a contemporaneous Tartu-specific report/date if available within permitted public sources.
No end time or response information for Tartu.
title: Marriage-equality demonstration in Tartu reported as early October
threshold_50_evidence: ERR reports about 150 people at a separate demonstration in Tartu supporting the same changes; article places it at the beginning of October, with exact day unknown.

start_date.summary: ERR says the similar Tartu demonstration occurred at the beginning of October; exact day unknown.

demands.summary: Support for marriage-equality changes and opposition to the planned referendum on defining marriage as between a man and a woman.

threshold_50.summary: About 150 at the Tartu gathering establishes at least 50.

protester_violence.summary: Not reported for this separate Tartu gathering; unknown.

state_response.summary: No Tartu-specific state response reported; unknown.
